SessionControllerSitlTest.result: FLAKY: failed the plan's extra wall bound only in both T15 runs; passed in the independent review re-run
SessionControllerSitlTest.explanation: The extra wall bound (one echo-stream period + WALL_MARGIN_MS 60) is borderline on this host: the margin depends on ArduCopter's wall-time scheduling jitter at the simulator's current speed (0.60-0.76x seen). Spec M2 (p95 <= 300 ms at real time) passed in all three runs. Takeoff, four five-step plans, STOP -> BRAKE and land passed before the final assertion in every run. The bound was not loosened; follow-up: scale WALL_MARGIN_MS by simulator speed.
